title: Open a formatted pull request with local git and mocked GitHub
narrative: Fangore asks guided coding to compare the feature branch to main with local git, draft a clear pull request summary, and open the PR. GitHub itself stays mocked so CI and live Completer walks do not need forge credentials; only the local git history is real. Complements `fangore_coding_git_inspect` and `fangore_guided_coding_recipe`.
implementation: Agentic Recipe catalog id `guided_coding` with `environment.local_work: project_coding`, `coding_git: local_mock_pr` (`RecordingPullRequestCodingGit` over `LocalProcessCodingGit`), and `git_seed: feature_branch`. Tools `git_log` / `git_diff` / `create_pull_request` hit injectable `CodingGit`. Production PR path is `LocalGitHttpPullRequestCodingGit` + `HttpGitHubClient` / `GitHubConnectionConfig` (HTTP token via `ProjectCodingConfig.get_github_client()` — no `gh` required). Stories keep the forge mocked.
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `open_pr.yaml` in suite `fangore_guided_coding`. Static mode uses `coding_tool_script: git_open_pr`. Live Completer may draft title/body but still uses the mock PR publisher under `local_mock_pr`. Asserts `.mechaharness/pr_url.txt` contains the mock URL. Unit coverage in `tests/test_github_client.py` and `tests/test_coding_git.py`.
